$comment: Canonical list of filesystem paths re3 touches, grouped by category (see docs/GAME_ASSETS.md). Contains only relative *paths*, never asset content -- paths are not copyrighted. Consumed by scripts/validate_assets.py (native pre-flight check) and web/vfs.js (in-browser validation before handing off to the engine). Paths are relative to the configured asset root (default mount point /game) and are matched case-insensitively, mirroring src/skel/crossplatform.cpp's casepath().

gameAssets.$comment: Real GTA III data. Never generated, packaged, or committed by this repo -- the user supplies their own legally obtained copy. 'required' entries are hard dependencies the engine asserts/crashes without (see docs/GAME_ASSETS.md for the exact source line of each); 'optional' entries are checked gracefully by the engine and skipped if absent.

required.why: Level manifest: lists every IDE/IPL/COLFILE/etc the engine loads. Parsed by CFileLoader::LoadLevel (src/core/FileLoader.cpp) and CGame::Initialise (src/core/Game.cpp:503).
Main streamed model/texture archive, opened with a raw fd by CdStreamInit (src/core/CdStreamPosix.cpp:202) -- hardcoded relative path, asserts if missing.
Default (American English) text table, loaded by CText::Load (src/text/Text.cpp).
Compiled main mission script, run by CTheScripts.

optional.why: Generated/cached texture archive. Checked with CFileMgr::OpenFile first and only added if present (src/core/Streaming.cpp:267); safe to be absent -- re3 builds it from loose TXDs instead.
Streamed radio/mission audio (AUDIO\*.OPUS via StreamedNameTable, src/audio/sampman.h). Large; individual tracks are only needed for the missions/stations that use them.
FMV intro/cutscenes. Not required for gameplay; skipped entirely if NO_MOVIES is defined.
Non-default language text tables; only needed if the user selects that language.

engineFiles.$comment: Ship with re3 itself (gamefiles/ in this repo) -- not GTA III content, not subject to the copyrighted-asset restriction. Currently unused under the WASM build specifically (see notes) but listed for completeness / native build parity.

files.why: SDL gamepad mapping DB, loaded by _InputInitialiseJoys (src/skel/glfw/glfw.cpp). Loading is compiled out under __EMSCRIPTEN__ because Emscripten's GLFW port doesn't implement glfwUpdateGamepadMappings (see docs/BROWSER_RUNTIME.md) -- listed here for native-build parity only.

configFiles.$comment: Small, human-editable settings. Not required to pre-exist -- the engine creates them with defaults on first run if absent.

files.why: Legacy version marker read by some installers; not read by re3 itself.

files.location: user files directory (see below), not the asset root
files.why: Control bindings and video/audio prefs, read/written by CMenuManager::LoadSettings/SaveSettings (src/core/Frontend.cpp).

saveFiles.$comment: Player save games. Written under the *user files* directory, never the read-only asset root -- see docs/GAME_ASSETS.md.

logFiles.$comment: Debug-only output, not read back by the engine.

files.location: current working directory at the time it's opened (see src/control/Script.cpp)
files.why: Script debugger log, opened directly with fopen() (bypasses CFileMgr).

tempFiles.$comment: No engine-managed temp files were found that need special VFS handling; re3 doesn't currently write scratch/cache files outside of saves and SCRDBG.LOG.
